caption: The drawing depicts a metal trivet consisting of a circular, open-frame structure with a central five-pointed star (pentagram) design, enclosed by two circular borders that are further segmented by radial bars. The trivet has a handle attached to the side, also composed of bent metal forming a loop. Three short legs extend downward to give elevation. The illustration uses shades of gray and black on a beige background. There are three views shown: an overhead view at the top left, a side elevation in the center left, and a perspective view occupying the lower right, displaying the object’s form and structure. At the bottom left is a linear scale measured in inches, and the name "G.P. SANBORN" is written in small text.
title: Flat Iron Holder
